parent_design.inheritance: All scientific, data, causal, output, evaluation and claim contracts are unchanged.

single_change.r1_failure: Guard cast a deserialized UTC DateTime to a culture string, lost the Z designator and reparsed it as Hong Kong local time.
single_change.repair: Guard preserves DateTime/DateTimeOffset objects and converts them directly to UTC before freshness comparison.

inherited_exactly.inputs: R0 frozen replay, RGB, Development truth and natural-event identities
inherited_exactly.causality: current plus immediate previous frame only; no future frame
inherited_exactly.shape_guard: Native decoded (H,W) mismatch gives both arms FRAME_SHAPE_CHANGE; current becomes next history; no resize/pad/crop/bridge.
inherited_exactly.event_evaluable: At least 3 finite rows and coverage >= 0.50; abstentions remain in denominator.
inherited_exactly.readiness_floor: correct >= 0.60; wrong-signed <= 0.20; evaluable >= 0.80; each truth-state correct >= 0.50
inherited_exactly.flow_over_bbox: correct gain >=2; wrong-sign not increase; evaluable loss <=23; positive both targets; positive at least two regions; at least two improved events

r2_producer_allowlist: R0 frozen REveL RGB image root
outcome_firewall.truth_join_order: Only after a new R2 guarded producer exits COMPLETE and its exact identity/keyset/shape contract passes.

required_order: Implement only R2 identity wrappers, adapter, bindings and regression fixtures.
Freeze and independently pass R2 implementation identity.
Run two post-lock no-truth 2,000-row pilots and require output equivalence plus progress complete.
Validate a new guarded-host preflight bound to repaired guard and R2 adapter.
Run one new R2 guarded producer in the new namespace.
Only after COMPLETE run one conditional Development evaluator.

failure_and_stop.valid_terminal: Accept the unchanged frozen scientific terminal without tuning or rerun.

authority.design_review_pass_effect: Implementation, fixtures, no-truth pilot and preflight preparation only.
